say:3:1520818001:1.text: Oboe, Grift—you both did very well just now.
say:3:1520818001:1.source_cn: 欧布，费斗，你们刚才做得很好。

say:4:1520818002:1.text: But it seems you forgot this was a competition.
say:4:1520818002:1.source_cn: 但你们似乎忘了，这是一场比赛。

say:6:1520818004:0.text: Even counting that last one as Grift's kill, I still took down more wolves with my bow than he did with his spear!
say:6:1520818004:0.source_cn: 即使把这只算作费斗的猎物，我用箭杀死的野狼也一定比他用...

say:7:1520818005:0.text: If you don't believe me, Father, go ahead and count them yourself!
say:7:1520818005:0.source_cn: 如果阿爹你不信，就尽管去数一数！

say:8:1520818006:1.text: If you're so capable, why did you work with Grift?
say:8:1520818006:1.source_cn: 要是你这么有能耐，为什么还要和费斗合作？

say:9:1520818007:0.text: It wasn't teamwork—I was helping him!

say:10:1520818008:0.text: That wolf was too quick and agile for Grift's spear.
say:10:1520818008:0.source_cn: 这只狼跑得太快了，动作也很敏捷。费斗的矛根本刺不中它。

say:11:1520818009:1.text: She's right. I couldn't get close on my own. Oboe helped me.
say:11:1520818009:1.source_cn: 没错，我没办法单独靠近它。是欧布帮了我。

say:12:1520818010:1.text: If that's true, then Oboe did well enough.
say:12:1520818010:1.source_cn: 真是这样的话，欧布做的还算不错。

say:13:1520818011:0.text: ...It's been a long time since I've heard you say anything like that, Father.

say:17:1520818012:0.text: So, who gets credit for killing this wolf?
say:17:1520818012:0.source_cn: 那么，这只狼该算是谁的猎物？

say:18:1520818013:0.text: The Herdmaster is here. It's up to him to decide.
say:18:1520818013:0.source_cn: 狩猎神在此，自然要交给<male>他</male><f...
say:18:1520818013:0.male: The Herdmaster is here. It's up to him to decide.
say:18:1520818013:0.female: The Herdmaster is here. It's up to her to decide.

choice_prompt:19:1520818013.text: The Herdmaster is here. It's up to him to decide.
choice_prompt:19:1520818013.source_cn: 狩猎神在此，自然要交给<male>他</male><female>她</female>定夺。
choice_prompt:19:1520818013.male: The Herdmaster is here. It's up to him to decide.
choice_prompt:19:1520818013.female: The Herdmaster is here. It's up to her to decide.

say:20:1520818014:0.text: Yes. That acknowledges both their skills fairly.
say:20:1520818014:0.source_cn: 好。这样做既肯定了他们的能力，又不失公平。
say:20:1520818014:0.male: Yes. That acknowledges both their skills fairly.
say:20:1520818014:0.female: Yes. That acknowledges both their skills fairly.

say:21:1520818016:0.text: Now it's time for the final tally. I'll send someone to count the kills. We'll have results by sunset.
say:21:1520818016:0.source_cn: 接下来就该清点猎物了。我会派人过来，在日落之前完成这件事。

say:22:1520818017:0.text: <style="highlight">The Herdmaster will bestow divine favor and weapon upon the victor at the blessing ceremony.</style>
say:22:1520818017:0.male: <style="highlight">The Herdmaster will bestow divine favor and weapon upon the victor at the blessing ceremony.</style>
say:22:1520818017:0.female: <style="highlight">The Herdmaster will bestow divine favor and weapon upon the victor at the blessing ceremony.</style>

say:23:1520818018:0.text: You two, head back to the valley. And remember your lessons!
say:23:1520818018:0.source_cn: 你们两个，现在回山谷去，不许再对同伴动手！

say:33:1520818020:0.text: Kordan, you're very hard on Oboe.

say:34:1520818021:0.text: Hardship forges the strongest warriors. It is the only way.
say:34:1520818021:0.source_cn: 这都是为了让她长成可靠的战士。

choice_prompt:35:1520818021.text: Hardship forges the strongest warriors. It is the only way.
choice_prompt:35:1520818021.source_cn: 这都是为了让她长成可靠的战士。

say:36:1520818022:0.text: Being praised by the Herdmaster is her greatest honor.
say:36:1520818022:0.source_cn: 能得到兽群之主的夸奖，是她的荣幸。
say:36:1520818022:0.male: Being praised by the Herdmaster is her greatest honor.
say:36:1520818022:0.female: Being praised by the Herdmaster is her greatest honor.

say:37:1520818025:0.text: But she must also prove her worth. These wild wolves were an appropriate test.
say:37:1520818025:0.source_cn: 但她也必须证明自己足够有用。这些野狼可以。

say:38:1520818026:0.text: <style="highlight">When the blessing ceremony arrives</style>, we'll reveal the outcome of this trial.

say:39:1520818027:0.text: If Oboe truly wins, the honor you bestow—the title of Chosen Warrior—will be hers forever!
say:39:1520818027:0.source_cn: 若是欧布真能胜出，你赐予的荣光——雅库伯尔勇士的称号将...

choice:35:1:2.text: Give the kid more room to grow.
choice:35:1:2.source_cn: 多给孩子一点成长的空间
choice:35:1:2.male: Give the kid more room to grow.
choice:35:1:2.female: Give the kid more room to grow.

say:42:1520818024:0.text: I must admit, that's one of my failings.
say:42:1520818024:0.source_cn: 我必须承认，这是我的不足。
say:42:1520818024:0.male: I must admit, that's one of my failings.
say:42:1520818024:0.female: I must admit, that's one of my failings.

choice:35:2:3.text: I don't like your parenting methods.
choice:35:2:3.source_cn: 我不喜欢你的教育方式
choice:35:2:3.male: I don't like your parenting methods.
choice:35:2:3.female: I don't like your parenting methods.

choice:19:0:1.text: It counts for both of them.
choice:19:0:1.male: It counts for both of them.
choice:19:0:1.female: It counts for both of them.

say:43:1520818015:0.text: Fair enough. That's the most impartial decision.
say:43:1520818015:0.male: Fair enough. That's the most impartial decision.
say:43:1520818015:0.female: Fair enough. That's the most impartial decision.
